programme.title: SkyMed
programme.desc: The SkyMed team must rally despite personal differences and challenges to search for a missing medevac with four flight crew members aboard.

programme.title: R.J. Decker
programme.desc: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: On the night before her wedding Fran gets lost in New Jersey while picking up her honeymoon negligee. Even with the last minute disapproval by Maxwell’s family, he still marries his beloved Nanny. When finally alone together after six years on their honeymoon yacht, Fran and Maxwell fall overboard.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: After a Jewish, high-voiced, woman from Flushing, New York gets fired from her job and dumped by her boyfriend, Fran Fine (Fran Drescher) is mistaken as applying for a nanny for widowed Maxwell Sheffield (Charles Shaughnessy), who has three children, Maggie (Nicholle Tom), Brighton (Benjamin Salisbury), and Grace (Madeline Zima), when she is stuck selling cosmetics in Manhattan. As she spends years there, she becomes great friends with the butler, Niles (Daniel Davis), and the three kids. She is good friends with the widowed man, and some romance sparks through the years.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: On Fran and Maxwell’s honeymoon aboard the yacht, Fran falls overboard and Maxwell jumps in to rescue her. They manage to make it to a deserted island. There, they have some good times and bad times in their survival, but the worst ends up being a poisonous bite that Maxwell receives. He thinks he’s going to die, but luckily for him, Fran watched daytime television in the past which gave her the necessary skills to tend to his illness. Meanwhile, they are noticed missing when the yacht docked at its first port without them. The Sheffield kids, Sylvia and Niles fear the worst. After a week of the Coast Guard not being able to locate any sign of Fran and Maxwell dead or alive, C.C. decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: During their first night together in the house, Maxwell ”shushes” Fran because he thinks she’s making too much noise and that she’ll be heard by the kids. Basically, Maxwell thinks that Fran is too ”loud” and Fran thinks that Maxwell is too uptight. They get into a terrible argument about what is to them a fundamental aspect of who each other is. After speaking to their respective confidantes - Fran with Sylvia and Maxwell with Niles - each decides to compromise to make their marriage work. The first test is a business party in which Maxwell needs Fran to be on her best behavior since a lucrative production could be offered to him by the party’s host, playwright Wendell Kent. As usual, Maxwell’s main competition for the job is Andrew Lloyd Webber. Things seem to be going well for the Sheffields - Kent is enthralled with vivacious Fran - until they get locked in the bathroom together. Maxwell doesn’t want to draw attention to themselves by Fran yelling for help, yet he really needs to relieve himself, something the uptight part of him can’t do in front on anyone, including his wife. In accommodating her husband, Fran is the cause of an incident which costs Maxwell the job. Because of the severity of the incident, Fran and Maxwell decide that they are better off being themselves in their marriage. But Maxwell is later grateful for Fran helping him get out of the job.

programme.title: Married with Children
programme.desc: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle-aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: Wild Cards
programme.desc: A spirited con woman and a demoted by-the-book detective are given the chance to redeem themselves. The catch? They have to find a way to work together each using their unique skills to solve crimes.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: During a disagreement in a parenting issue with Brighton, Maxwell accidentally calls Fran the N word: nanny. Fran is upset. For Fran to get back at Maxwell, Sylvia suggests that Fran act like a wife and do what any good wife would do in this situation - withhold sex - but Fran finds this tactic more difficult than the intended effect on Maxwell. They eventually make up as it’s nothing that some new, expensive jewelry can’t fix. Later on national television, Maxwell talks about his new wife in a not so flattering way, again referring to her as the nanny. Again Fran is hurt, and again Maxwell needs to buy Fran some expensive jewelry to get himself out of the doghouse. To get out of this cycle, Fran hires another nanny, namely Nanny Bower. With all this free time now on her hands, Fran does what the first Mrs. Sheffield used to do, which is to hang out at the country club. Fran quickly learns that she’s not cut out for country club life. Nanny Bower also quickly realizes that the Sheffield house does not really require a nanny. Maxwell and Fran come to the conclusion that Fran is indeed the nanny, but now in another name: mom.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Sara’s parent’s are coming for a visit. Roberta and Ernest - Bert and Ernie as Fran calls them - are proper and somewhat uptight. Maxwell has told them nothing about Fran and himself. Upon Roberta and Ernest’s arrival, Maxwell and Fran have to quickly tell them about the marriage to overcome an otherwise embarrassing situation. But Fran wants to win them over before she and Maxwell tell them about Fran adopting the kids. She thinks things are going well, that is until she tells them about the adoption. Roberta forbids it to happen and threatens to take Maxwell and Fran to court. Fran is worried that she will be proved unfit mother material due to all her past indiscretions in life. But perhaps Roberta and Ernest’s concern has little to do with Fran as a person and more with their future connection with their grandchildren. Elsewhere, Yetta thinks that Niles is her husband.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Maggie is nervous and excited about bringing her Jewish boyfriend Michael over to the house to meet Maxwell and Fran for the first time. Maxwell wants Fran to appear to Michael to be a demure mother figure. When Michael comes over, he and Maggie seem to be very serious about each other, which is exciting Fran. Maxwell on the other hand is furious at Fran for being so liberal with Maggie’s life. Maxwell states that Maggie needs a mother, not a friend. Indeed, Maggie states to Fran that she and Michael are going to move into together, again Maxwell blaming Fran for not being more mother-like in her advice to Maggie. To appease Maxwell, Sylvia suggests to Fran that she try old fashioned Jewish guilt to get Maggie to move back home. But guilt doesn’t work. But perhaps old fashioned reverse psychology may.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell know that Maggie and Michael are having sex with each other. How do Maggie’s parents know this?: because Fran and Maxwell find them in bed together. Maxwell isn’t too happy; he wants Fran to talk to Maggie about what she’s doing. Before Fran can do so, Maggie in turn wants to talk to Fran about a problem she’s having: she thinks she’s pregnant. Before telling Maxwell, Fran wants Maggie to be be sure and makes her take a home pregnancy test. But as Maxwell catches Maggie with the test, he would prefer that Maggie know for sure by going to a gynecologist for a test. With Fran in tow, Maggie gets the test done. Despite being late, Maggie is not showing any other signs of being pregnant. But someone else is showing signs of being pregnant, that being Fran. But Fran learns, pregnant or not, that Maxwell doesn’t want to be a new father or grandfather at this stage of his life. Meanwhile, Niles and C.C. are in negotiations for him to buy her classic car.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran is hesitating telling Maxwell about being pregnant. But Sylvia, Niles and C.C. all know. Fran finally decides to set the right mood to tell him, and before she can blurt it out, he reiterates his stance that he doesn’t want another child. In tears, she finally tells him; because she’s so upset, she runs off. She commiserates with another mother in Central Park when she starts to have abdominal pains. She’s rushed to the hospital. There, Maxwell reassures her that he does indeed want a child, something he didn’t know until he learned they were about to have one. Unfortunately, Fran and Maxwell will have to wait for another pregnancy. Meanwhile, Brighton and Yetta go to the movie theater together. Unsure who’s looking after who, they both lose each other, which they’re afraid to tell anyone about.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell learn that Fran didn’t lose the baby - she never had it to begin with. Hers was a false pregnancy. However that doesn’t make the news of ”no baby” any easier to hear. But Fran and Maxwell, having originally thought she was pregnant, are now in mindset of wanting a child. Fran in particular is desperate to get pregnant and will do whatever she can to help that process along. She goes to see a Chinese herbalist, Dr. Fu, who prescribes some magic herbs. But Fran also learns that she and Maxwell have to abstain from sex until she’s ovulating. Meanwhile, Maxwell learns that he’s been approached to be a celebrity panelist on Hollywood Squares (1998) (they couldn’t get Andrew Lloyd Webber), so he, Fran, Sylvia, Yetta and Val traipse off to California. Regardless of if Maxwell is having a good time on the show (he isn’t), Fran drags him off the set during the middle of the show for more important matters: she’s ovulating. Elsewhere, C.C. and Niles both fall under the spell of Dr. Fu’s aphrodisiac almond cookies.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran is obsessing about not being pregnant. To get her mind off this fact, Maxwell thinks Fran needs to get away on a vacation. She doesn’t really want to, until Maxwell tells her that he has managed to get the whole family invited to a state dinner in Aspen with President Bill Clinton. In Aspen, Fran makes quite the impression on the Clintons, whereas Maxwell came across as a babbling idiot. Fran made such an impression that the Clintons have invited her to go skiing with them. The problem: Fran doesn’t know how to ski. After Fran has some problems at ski school, Maxwell ends up teaching her. However in a mishap, Fran and Maxwell get caught in an out of bounds area and are lost. To keep warm, Fran and Maxwell decide to get close to each other. They are rescued, and Fran eventually learns how to ski. But just as she’s about to go skiing with the Clintons, Fran instead decides to spend time with Maxwell since she learned that their time lost was productive in more ways than one.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: It’s the December holiday season. Maxwell’s sister Jocelyn drops by unexpectedly from London to meet up with a new boyfriend, a meeting which doesn’t go as she hopes. Meanwhile, Maxwell has made plans to go to Boston for a one-day business trip on the first day of Hanukkah. Fran is upset that he forgot about spending what she considers the most important day of the holiday season with the family. But the entire family won’t be at home for the first day of Hanukkah either as, in addition to C.C., Maxwell is taking Grace with him to Boston. On the first day of Hanukkah, both Fran and Maxwell individually remember back to their respective childhoods about what the holidays were like. This remembrance is enough for Maxwell to realize that he’d rather be home. As Maxwell, C.C. and Grace are driving along during a blizzard, Maxwell calls Fran on his cell phone to tell her that they’re on their way home. But Fran overhears what she thinks is Maxwell accidentally driving off the road. She’s right. She and the family are worried for their loved ones. Meanwhile, Maxwell, C.C. and Grace are all right, but they are stranded without any way of getting hold of anyone (the phone has gone dead), and with what Maxwell thinks is enough gas in the car to keep the motor running for about an hour - an hour of warmth. But it’s Hanukkah, the season of miracles.

programme.title: The Originals
programme.desc: A spin-off from The Vampire Diaries and set in New Orleans, The Originals centers on the Mikaelson siblings, otherwise known as the world’s original vampires: Klaus (Joseph Morgan), Elijah (Daniel Gillies), and Rebekah (Claire Holt). Now Klaus must take down his protégé, Marcel (Charles Michael Davis), who is now in charge of New Orleans, in order to re-take his city, as he originally built New Orleans. Klaus departed from the city after being chased down by his father Mikael, while it was being constructed and Marcel took charge. As Klaus has returned after many years, his ego has provoked him to become the king of the city. ”Every King needs an heir” says Klaus, accepting the unborn child. The child is a first to be born to a hybrid (part vampire, part werewolf) and a werewolf (Hayley).

programme.title: Married with Children
programme.desc: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle-aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran’s wealthy Aunt Freida did not attend Maxwell and Fran’s wedding out of protest since she was not allowed to sing at the festivities. Knowing that it was Sylvia’s decision to not allow Freida to sing, Freida in retaliation has bought Sylvia and Morty’s apartment building and subsequently evicted her brother and sister-in-law. So the Fines decide to move into the Sheffield house. Initially Maxwell is livid, whereas Fran is somewhat looking forward to some nearby motherly love. However each takes a 180 degree turn when Sylvia continually criticizes Fran leading her to binge eat, whereas Sylvia ends up being the mother that Maxwell never really had. Fran thinks that she should be the mother that Maxwell never had. This turn of events is just a little too much for Maxwell to handle, who wants his life back to the way things were before the Fines moved in. Fran figures the only way to get Sylvia and Morty back into their old apartment is to manufacture Freida singing at their wedding, which she manages to do with a little help from the Sheffield kids and a video camera. Meanwhile, Niles tries everything in his power for Maxwell and C.C. to hire him for a photo shoot requiring a masculine male model.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Rodney Pembroke, Maxwell’s rich, boisterous friend, comes to New York for a visit. With Rodney, Fran sees probably one of the few times that Maxwell has ever let loose. During Rodney’s visit, Maxwell is unexpectedly called away to London, but Rodney tells Fran that Maxwell forgot to give him an investment check for $1 million. Against C.C.’s advice, Fran does write Rodney the check. Shortly thereafter, Fran learns that Rodney is broke and has squandered away all his and other friends’ money. When Fran asks for her money back, Rodney tells her a story about one bad investment he made which ruined his life and asks her to have a little faith. She does. When Maxwell returns from London, he already knows about Rodney’s unfortunate financial situation, so Fran needs to tread lightly when she tells him she invested their $1 million with Rodney. Although Maxwell is upset with Fran for doing so, Rodney may come through for them in the end. Concurrent with Rodney’s visit, Fran tries to impress a headmistress of a prestigious school so that Grace can be admitted. Niles learns that he has inherited an estate and title from a long, lost relative, and as such is on a work slowdown; he will quit work when he gets the money. And Val gets a new job working at Krispy Kreme Doughnuts.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran goes for a sonogram. Fran wants to know the baby’s gender, whereas Maxwell doesn’t. To take her mind off the wait to hear about the baby’s gender, Fran decides to accompany Brighton on his visits to colleges, much to his chagrin. At Harvard, Brighton ends up getting into a heated argument with other prospective students when they talk about Fran in a sexual way. Later, Brighton politely asks Fran not to accompany him on future college visits, but he refuses to tell her why. Hurt, she thinks she embarrassed him, probably by saying or doing something stupid. By chance, Fran manages to spend some quality time with Lynn Redgrave, who gives her a crash course in intelligence and class. However, Fran thinks it’s a futile task. Brighton later admits to Fran the real reason he doesn’t want her to come along, which is a big relief to her. Meanwhile, the sonogram reveals some unexpected information. And C.C. starts dating someone who treats her exactly like Niles does. Niles, jealous, decides to make a grand declaration to her.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: One of Maxwell’s plays may be picked up to be made into a movie. If so, the Sheffields are moving to California. They dread telling Sylvia, but she seems to be fine with the news. Donna Douglas convinces Fran that Sylvia is putting on an act and in reality her heart is breaking. Just as Maxwell is about the sign the contract, Fran stops him since she doesn’t want to leave Sylvia behind in New York. The studio boss, Maury Sherry, suggests they bring the senior Fines to live in Beverley Hills with them. When Sylvia hears the news, she tries to convince Fran that she really wants Fran to live her own life as she needs, and if Beverley Hills is where she needs to be, so be it. But Sylvia is staying put. Fran infers from this that Sylvia is dying. Fran learns second hand that Sylvia has been going to the hospital on a regular basis. Confronting Sylvia, Fran learns that Sylvia is not dying. So the only plausible explanation for her hospital visits is that she’s having an affair.

He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran’s wealthy Aunt Freida did not attend Maxwell and Fran’s wedding out of protest since she was not allowed to sing at the festivities. Knowing that it was Sylvia’s decision to not allow Freida to sing, Freida in retaliation has bought Sylvia and Morty’s apartment building and subsequently evicted her brother and sister-in-law. So the Fines decide to move into the Sheffield house. Initially Maxwell is livid, whereas Fran is somewhat looking forward to some nearby motherly love. However each takes a 180 degree turn when Sylvia continually criticizes Fran leading her to binge eat, whereas Sylvia ends up being the mother that Maxwell never really had. Fran thinks that she should be the mother that Maxwell never had. This turn of events is just a little too much for Maxwell to handle, who wants his life back to the way things were before the Fines moved in. Fran figures the only way to get Sylvia and Morty back into their old apartment is to manufacture Freida singing at their wedding, which she manages to do with a little help from the Sheffield kids and a video camera. Meanwhile, Niles tries everything in his power for Maxwell and C.C. to hire him for a photo shoot requiring a masculine male model.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Rodney Pembroke, Maxwell’s rich, boisterous friend, comes to New York for a visit. With Rodney, Fran sees probably one of the few times that Maxwell has ever let loose. During Rodney’s visit, Maxwell is unexpectedly called away to London, but Rodney tells Fran that Maxwell forgot to give him an investment check for $1 million. Against C.C.’s advice, Fran does write Rodney the check. Shortly thereafter, Fran learns that Rodney is broke and has squandered away all his and other friends’ money. When Fran asks for her money back, Rodney tells her a story about one bad investment he made which ruined his life and asks her to have a little faith. She does. When Maxwell returns from London, he already knows about Rodney’s unfortunate financial situation, so Fran needs to tread lightly when she tells him she invested their $1 million with Rodney. Although Maxwell is upset with Fran for doing so, Rodney may come through for them in the end. Concurrent with Rodney’s visit, Fran tries to impress a headmistress of a prestigious school so that Grace can be admitted. Niles learns that he has inherited an estate and title from a long, lost relative, and as such is on a work slowdown; he will quit work when he gets the money. And Val gets a new job working at Krispy Kreme Doughnuts.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Fran goes for a sonogram. Fran wants to know the baby’s gender, whereas Maxwell doesn’t. To take her mind off the wait to hear about the baby’s gender, Fran decides to accompany Brighton on his visits to colleges, much to his chagrin. At Harvard, Brighton ends up getting into a heated argument with other prospective students when they talk about Fran in a sexual way. Later, Brighton politely asks Fran not to accompany him on future college visits, but he refuses to tell her why. Hurt, she thinks she embarrassed him, probably by saying or doing something stupid. By chance, Fran manages to spend some quality time with Lynn Redgrave, who gives her a crash course in intelligence and class. However, Fran thinks it’s a futile task. Brighton later admits to Fran the real reason he doesn’t want her to come along, which is a big relief to her. Meanwhile, the sonogram reveals some unexpected information. And C.C. starts dating someone who treats her exactly like Niles does. Niles, jealous, decides to make a grand declaration to her.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: One of Maxwell’s plays may be picked up to be made into a movie. If so, the Sheffields are moving to California. They dread telling Sylvia, but she seems to be fine with the news. Donna Douglas convinces Fran that Sylvia is putting on an act and in reality her heart is breaking. Just as Maxwell is about the sign the contract, Fran stops him since she doesn’t want to leave Sylvia behind in New York. The studio boss, Maury Sherry, suggests they bring the senior Fines to live in Beverley Hills with them. When Sylvia hears the news, she tries to convince Fran that she really wants Fran to live her own life as she needs, and if Beverley Hills is where she needs to be, so be it. But Sylvia is staying put. Fran infers from this that Sylvia is dying. Fran learns second hand that Sylvia has been going to the hospital on a regular basis. Confronting Sylvia, Fran learns that Sylvia is not dying. So the only plausible explanation for her hospital visits is that she’s having an affair.

programme.title: Dashuri e Vërtetë
programme.desc: Holly Whitman and Carl Lindford are Chicago-based junior insurance lawyers working at the same firm and a couple in their personal life, although Carl seems more interested in his symbols of prestige, such as his BMW sports car and getting ahead in his career, than he is in Holly. Days before they are to enter court on what could be the case which brings them into the next echelon of the profession, Holly receives news from her irresponsible brother, Everett Whitman, that their father, Wade Whitman, has suffered a heart attack, Wade and Everett still living in their small hometown of Manion Lake, Alabama. Holly, borrowing Carl’s car, heads down to Manion Lake expecting to make it back to Chicago in time for the opening arguments of the important case. The trip is also despite Holly and Wade being estranged, due to what generally disagreeable Wade sees as Holly turning her back on family their life in Manion Lake for the pretense of the big city, and Holly believing Wade providing no ...

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: After Fran, under an assumed name, visits the kind and handsome Dr. Razzo who Sylvia has been seeing regularly, Sylvia admits that she’s having an affair with him. On the cusp of their fortieth anniversary, Sylvia feels that Morty pays her no attention. She is feeling not only unloved, but worse in her mind she is feeling neglected. Fran decides to talk to Morty to try and get him to treat Sylvia more romantically. Although he tries, he feels that romantic just isn’t him. Perhaps the only thing that can save Morty and Sylvia’s marriage is for him to take the advice of a kind and handsome doctor. Meanwhile, C.C., the dictatorial director of Grace’s grammar school stage production, needs to find a replacement to play an old haggard man. She believes she’s found the perfect person for the role.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Niles want to produce a play written by his friend. He doesn’t want to produce it solely in a want to be a producer, but he wants to impress his true love: C.C. To help her friend achieve his goal of winning C.C. (although she admittedly doesn’t understand the attraction), Fran decides to co-produce the show with Niles. Since the names Niles and Fran mean nothing in the show business world, they decide to use the name Sheffield/Babcock Productions to at least get their foot in the door. Even at that, the production has a few bumps, such as only being able to hire an aging former soap opera star in the lead role of the 24-year old ingénue. But Niles and Fran get into serious trouble when due to their lack of business acumen, Sheffield/Babcock Productions ends up being sued for $250,000. They try and hide this fact from both C.C. and Maxwell without success. Luckily Maxwell, although angry, manages to rectify their business mistakes in the production. But in the end, the show does go on. Feeling buoyed by this minor success and egged on by Fran, Niles is about to confess his love to C.C. Instead, he blurts out something completely different to her.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: After Niles blurts out a marriage proposal to C.C., she flatly turns him down. Niles is devastated and angry at Fran for pushing him into this situation. Fran thinks Niles’ mistake was that he took things too quickly with C.C. Fran suggests he court C.C., first by asking her out to dinner. C.C. reluctantly agrees. But at dinner, Niles proposes once again, and C.C. turns him down once again. Humiliated, Niles feels he can’t be around C.C. anymore and quits his job. After a heated argument with Niles, C.C. realizes that she too has outstayed her welcome at the Sheffield house and quits as well. But in the middle of the night when Fran and Maxwell rush to Niles’ room to convince him to stay, they find they can’t interrupt him during this important moment in his life. Meanwhile, Margot - Dr. Reynolds’ sister who is filling in for her conference bound sister - provides Maxwell and Fran with two baby dolls so that they can practice being parents to twins.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: While still shocked about finding out about Niles and CC’s secret affair, Fran and Maxwell worry about something else. Max’s biggest chance to beat Andrew Lloyd Webber at the Tonys is going to be wasted.

programme.title: A winter’s tale
programme.desc: Disa mijëra vjet më pare, hutët e dimrit ndërtuan një marrëveshje fati me brejtësit e llojit leming. Pothuajse cdo 4 vite, lemingët shtohen në numër shumë të madh. Kështu, hutët e dimrit kanë ushqim të mjaftueshëm për t’i ushqyer të vegjlit e tyre. Hutët mund të shumohen deri në 11 zogjë të vegjël, dhe secili prej tyre ka nevojë për 4 lemingë në ditë. Kohëve të fundit, shumimi i lemingëve në përgjithësi nuk ka qenë aq i rregullt në disa pjesë të Tundra. Çfarë do të ndodh me ta dhe hutët e dimrit?

programme.title: BURRI I SHTËPISË
programme.desc: Mike Baxter is the marketing director for an iconic outdoor sporting goods store. He loves to have adventures while he’s traveling for work and, of course, he drives a pick-up truck. While Mike is king of the hill at work, he’s the odd man out in a home that is dominated by women -- namely his wife, Vanessa, and their three daughters, 22- year-old Kristin, 17-year-old Mandy and 14-year-old Eve. After being a stay-at-home mom for years, Vanessa recently returned to the workplace and was quickly promoted (much to the dismay of her primarily male co-workers). As a result of Vanessa’s increased work load, Mike is pulled into more hands-on parenting than ever before.

programme.title: BURRI I SHTËPISË

As a result of Vanessa’s increased work load, Mike is pulled into more hands-on parenting than ever before.

programme.title: Married with Children
programme.desc: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle-aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: The Originals
programme.desc: A spin-off from The Vampire Diaries and set in New Orleans, The Originals centers on the Mikaelson siblings, otherwise known as the world’s original vampires: Klaus (Joseph Morgan), Elijah (Daniel Gillies), and Rebekah (Claire Holt). Now Klaus must take down his protégé, Marcel (Charles Michael Davis), who is now in charge of New Orleans, in order to re-take his city, as he originally built New Orleans. Klaus departed from the city after being chased down by his father Mikael, while it was being constructed and Marcel took charge. As Klaus has returned after many years, his ego has provoked him to become the king of the city. ”Every King needs an heir” says Klaus, accepting the unborn child. The child is a first to be born to a hybrid (part vampire, part werewolf) and a werewolf (Hayley).

programme.title: Dashuri e Vërtetë
programme.desc: Holly Whitman and Carl Lindford are Chicago-based junior insurance lawyers working at the same firm and a couple in their personal life, although Carl seems more interested in his symbols of prestige, such as his BMW sports car and getting ahead in his career, than he is in Holly. Days before they are to enter court on what could be the case which brings them into the next echelon of the profession, Holly receives news from her irresponsible brother, Everett Whitman, that their father, Wade Whitman, has suffered a heart attack, Wade and Everett still living in their small hometown of Manion Lake, Alabama. Holly, borrowing Carl’s car, heads down to Manion Lake expecting to make it back to Chicago in time for the opening arguments of the important case. The trip is also despite Holly and Wade being estranged, due to what generally disagreeable Wade sees as Holly turning her back on family their life in Manion Lake for the pretense of the big city, and Holly believing Wade providing no ...

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: After Fran, under an assumed name, visits the kind and handsome Dr. Razzo who Sylvia has been seeing regularly, Sylvia admits that she’s having an affair with him. On the cusp of their fortieth anniversary, Sylvia feels that Morty pays her no attention. She is feeling not only unloved, but worse in her mind she is feeling neglected. Fran decides to talk to Morty to try and get him to treat Sylvia more romantically. Although he tries, he feels that romantic just isn’t him. Perhaps the only thing that can save Morty and Sylvia’s marriage is for him to take the advice of a kind and handsome doctor. Meanwhile, C.C., the dictatorial director of Grace’s grammar school stage production, needs to find a replacement to play an old haggard man. She believes she’s found the perfect person for the role.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Niles want to produce a play written by his friend. He doesn’t want to produce it solely in a want to be a producer, but he wants to impress his true love: C.C. To help her friend achieve his goal of winning C.C. (although she admittedly doesn’t understand the attraction), Fran decides to co-produce the show with Niles. Since the names Niles and Fran mean nothing in the show business world, they decide to use the name Sheffield/Babcock Productions to at least get their foot in the door. Even at that, the production has a few bumps, such as only being able to hire an aging former soap opera star in the lead role of the 24-year old ingénue. But Niles and Fran get into serious trouble when due to their lack of business acumen, Sheffield/Babcock Productions ends up being sued for $250,000. They try and hide this fact from both C.C. and Maxwell without success. Luckily Maxwell, although angry, manages to rectify their business mistakes in the production. But in the end, the show does go on. Feeling buoyed by this minor success and egged on by Fran, Niles is about to confess his love to C.C. Instead, he blurts out something completely different to her.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: After Niles blurts out a marriage proposal to C.C., she flatly turns him down. Niles is devastated and angry at Fran for pushing him into this situation. Fran thinks Niles’ mistake was that he took things too quickly with C.C. Fran suggests he court C.C., first by asking her out to dinner. C.C. reluctantly agrees. But at dinner, Niles proposes once again, and C.C. turns him down once again. Humiliated, Niles feels he can’t be around C.C. anymore and quits his job. After a heated argument with Niles, C.C. realizes that she too has outstayed her welcome at the Sheffield house and quits as well. But in the middle of the night when Fran and Maxwell rush to Niles’ room to convince him to stay, they find they can’t interrupt him during this important moment in his life. Meanwhile, Margot - Dr. Reynolds’ sister who is filling in for her conference bound sister - provides Maxwell and Fran with two baby dolls so that they can practice being parents to twins.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: While still shocked about finding out about Niles and CC’s secret affair, Fran and Maxwell worry about something else. Max’s biggest chance to beat Andrew Lloyd Webber at the Tonys is going to be wasted.

programme.title: Married with Children
programme.desc: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle-aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: SkyMed

programme.title: R.J. Decker
programme.desc: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Since he has a long term modeling contract in Japan, Michael asks Maggie to marry him so that she can go with him. She excitedly accepts. Fran is ecstatic, but Maxwell thinks Maggie is too young and forbids her to marry him. However, Fran and Maggie are able to convince Maxwell that she loves him enough that the marriage will work. Just before the ceremony, Fran learns that Michael’s cousin will be attending the wedding. His cousin is James Brolin which means that Barbra Streisand will also be there. Excited, Fran goes into premature labor. Although the labor is false and the ceremony is postponed, Fran is stuck in the hospital recuperating while Barbra is at the house. Fran sneaks back to the house, however Maxwell got Barbra to meet her at the hospital. So, Fran never does meet her idol. But the wedding does go off without a hitch. Meanwhile, Fran and Maxwell know that Niles and C.C. have been continuing their romantic liaison following catching them in bed together. C.C. eventually finds out that they know.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Libby, the receptionist at the Chatterbox, tells Fran and Val their fortunes. Val’s is good: the letter ”F”, which Val attributes to Fred the pharmacist, a condo and lots of babies. Fran’s is not so good: Maxwell in bed in Beverley Hills with a sexy, leggy blond with piercing blue eyes. In Fran’s hormonal state, she’s devastated with this prediction. It becomes even worse as Val’s prediction seems to be coming true when she and Fred start dating. It seems like Fran’s prediction is also moving toward reality when Maxwell is called off to Beverley Hills on a business trip. What’s more, he taking along with him a sexy, leggy blue-eyed blond: C.C. Not only is Fran concerned, but now so is Niles. They decide to go out to Beverley Hills themselves and see if Maxwell and C.C. end up together in bed. When they arrive in Beverley Hills, Fran manages to sneak into Maxwell’s room, and Niles manages to sneak into C.C.’s room. Although Fran does catch Maxwell in bed with a blue-eyed blond, it’s not quite what she had originally pictured. Meanwhile, Brighton, who has been accepted to Harvard, decides he wants to take a year off from school to travel the world to find himself.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Maxwell and Fran will soon be celebrating their first wedding anniversary, yet without Fran having given birth. Fran is a little anxious and a lot uncomfortable. To get her mind off the pregnancy, Fran decides to plan an anniversary party. There, the romantic mood makes Niles propose to C.C. yet again. This time, C.C. does not turn him down, but she runs off without giving him an answer. Fran runs after C.C. to find out what’s on her mind. Catching up to her in the elevator, C.C. admits to Fran that she doesn’t understand why Niles wants to marry her. Quickly thereafter, the two get stuck in the malfunctioning elevator, followed by Fran going into labor. Their time in captivity is spent by Fran trying to talk C.C. into marrying Niles, punctuated by screams of labor pains. When they find out about Fran and C.C., Maxwell, the kids and Niles - with the elevator repairman in tow - rush off to save their loved ones. At the closed elevator door, C.C. gives Niles her answer. They just have to pry open the door and get Fran to the hospital.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: A nervous Fran is in the hospital almost ready to give birth to the twins. Meanwhile, C.C. is also glad to be at the hospital since she’s been vomiting ever since she accepted Niles’ marriage proposal earlier that evening. She wonders if nausea is due to the proposal itself affecting her mental state. Fran convinces her that she’s just nervous about being married. So to get over the nerves, C.C. and Niles decide to get married in Fran’s hospital room right in the middle of her delivery. Although the nausea does subside after the ceremony, C.C. learns her nausea is due to something more natural. Back with Fran, she finally gets her nine month wish of getting the babies out of her: she gives birth to two beautiful babies. This act is the beginning of the next phase for the Sheffields, with Maggie and Brighton heading off to Europe, and Fran, Maxwell, Grace and the two babies - Jonah Samuel and Eve Katherine - heading to a California for their new life.

programme.title: The Originals
programme.desc: A spin-off from The Vampire Diaries and set in New Orleans, The Originals centers on the Mikaelson siblings, otherwise known as the world’s original vampires: Klaus (Joseph Morgan), Elijah (Daniel Gillies), and Rebekah (Claire Holt). Now Klaus must take down his protégé, Marcel (Charles Michael Davis), who is now in charge of New Orleans, in order to re-take his city, as he originally built New Orleans. Klaus departed from the city after being chased down by his father Mikael, while it was being constructed and Marcel took charge. As Klaus has returned after many years, his ego has provoked him to become the king of the city. ”Every King needs an heir” says Klaus, accepting the unborn child. The child is a first to be born to a hybrid (part vampire, part werewolf) and a werewolf (Hayley).

programme.title: Grosse Pointe Garden Society
programme.desc: In a wealthy suburb where everything appears to be perfect on the surface, four members of the local garden club come together to cover up a murder -- while dealing with drama and scandals in their messy personal lives.

programme.title: Married with Children
programme.desc: Al Bundy is an unsuccessful middle-aged shoe salesman with a miserable life and an equally dysfunctional family. He has a very attractive but lazy wife named Peggy who constantly nags him to death while throwing the little money he earns away on herself. He also has a very promiscuous teen-aged daughter named Kelly who makes up in attractiveness what she lacks in IQ points, and a not-so-attractive but bright teen-aged son named Bud who seems to think he is a ladies’ man. To add to Al’s misery is his yuppie next-door neighbors Marcy and Steve. They eventually split up with Marcy keeping the house next door to the Bundys and Steve moving away to be a forest ranger. Later, Marcy gets remarried to a gigolo named Jefferson, who is the male version of Peggy. The sitcom revolves around Al’s never-ending attempts to better his life which always lead him right back to where he started.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. This elite unit brings to bear all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe. Born into a multigenerational law enforcement family, Special Agent Maggie Bell commits deeply to the people she works with as well as those she protects. Her partner is Special Agent Omar Adom ”OA” Zidan, a West Point graduate via Bushwick who spent two years undercover for the DEA before being cherry-picked by the FBI. Overseeing them is Special Agent in Charge, Isobel Castille, who operates under intense pressure and has undeniable command authority. The team also includes Assistant Special Agent in Charge Jubal Valentine, the nerve center of the office whose ability to easily relate to and engage with both superiors and subordinates makes him a master motivator. Kristen Chazal is the team’s most valued resource, a brilliant analyst recruited straight out of university who can piece together the big picture faster than anyone. These first-class agents tenaciously investigate cases of tremendous magnitude, including terrorism, organized crime and counterintelligence.

programme.title: Histori familjare
programme.desc: Diagnoza që gjejnë në internet Xhei dhe Meni në lidhje me sëmundjen e Xheit i përkeqëson gjërat. Vizita e mamasë së Kameronit e çmend Miçëllin. Fili mërzitet më shumë se vetë Heili për ndarjen e saj me Dilanin.

programme.title: Histori familjare
programme.desc: Kler ndjehet e kërcënuar kur Gloria bëhet bashkëkryetare me të për një vallëzim në shkollë. Xhei tallet me Filin që mban qëndrim gjatë një udhëtimi për në qendrën tregtare. Miçëlli dhe Kameroni zbulojnë se vajza e tyre kafshon.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. This elite unit brings to bear all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe. Born into a multigenerational law enforcement family, Special Agent Maggie Bell commits deeply to the people she works with as well as those she protects. Her partner is Special Agent Omar Adom ”OA” Zidan, a West Point graduate via Bushwick who spent two years undercover for the DEA before being cherry-picked by the FBI. Overseeing them is Special Agent in Charge, Isobel Castille, who operates under intense pressure and has undeniable command authority. The team also includes Assistant Special Agent in Charge Jubal Valentine, the nerve center of the office whose ability to easily relate to and engage with both superiors and subordinates makes him a master motivator. Kristen Chazal is the team’s most valued resource, a brilliant analyst recruited straight out of university who can piece together the big picture faster than anyone. These first-class agents tenaciously investigate cases of tremendous magnitude, including terrorism, organized crime and counterintelligence.

programme.title: Shpëtoni ushtarin Rajan
programme.desc: Një kryevepër e kinematografisë. Film fitues i 5 çmimeve Oskar. Nga regjisori Steven Spielberg. Me Tom Hanks, Matt Damon, Edward Burns dhe Tom Sizemore. Lufta e II Botërore. Një grup i vogël ushtarësh, nisen me një mison: të gjejnë dhe të marrin me vete ushtarin Rajan, vëllezërit e të cilit ishin vrarë të gjithë në luftë.

programme.title: Punë shtrigash: Trashëgimia
programme.desc: Vazhdimi i filmit kult të viteve ’90. Një grup vajzash të shkollës së mesme që praktikojnë magjinë, fitojnë fuqi të jashtëzakonshme falë një rituali. Por argëtimi dhe ngazëllimi fillestar me fuqitë e reja, merr shpejt një kthesë të errët.

programme.title: Në Bryzh
programme.desc: Supozohej qe ata duhet te ishin zhdukur dhe te prisnin per telefonaten e bosit. Ne Bryzh.nese s’mund te fshihesh dot, te fshijne nga faqja e dheut pergjithmone.

programme.title: Resident Alien
programme.desc: Një alien i ardhur në tokë merr identitetin e një mjeku të qytetit të vogël të Kolorados dhe ngadalë fillon të luftojë me dilemën morale të misionit të tij sekret në Tokë.

programme.title: Në Kërkim Të Suksesit
programme.desc: Kur jetesa në qytetin e vogël Bei i kishte ardhur në majë të hundës, Adela August lë familjen dhe burrin e saj të dytë e niset për në Beverli Hills, bashke me vajzën e saj, Ana. Vajza adoleshente shkon me nënën e saj, por bën plane për të bërë Universitetin në bregun lindor. Por nëna e saj kishte plane të tjera për të. Ajo donte që vajza e saj të bëhej aktore.

programme.title: Vajza e karatesë
programme.desc: Xhuli eshte nje vajze e mbyllur ne vetvete, e cila ka vetem nje mik; nje fajkua te plagosur qe e mban ne nje vend te fshehte. Por kur ne shtepine e saj do te vije z.Miagi, Xhulia do te kuptoje forcen e saj dhe deshiren per drejtesi.

programme.title: Në Ndjekje të Ëndrrave
programme.desc: Një ngjarje prekëse rrëfen jetën pasionante të një çifti të ri që jeton në rrethinat e Konektikatit, të cilët vendosin të rrezikojnë gjithçka për të ndjekur ëndrrat e tyre.

programme.title: Diktatori
programme.desc: Sacha Baron Cohen. Diktatori më famëkeq i ditëve tona, shkon në Nju Jork. Pas një sërë ngjarjesh do të humbasë pushtetin edhe mjekrën, pa të cilën nuk e njeh askush. Këtu fillon makthi i tij më i madh:përjetimi i ’Ëndrrës Amerikane’.

programme.title: Kaçurrelja Su
programme.desc: Bill Danser dhe kaçurrelja Su jane 2 të pastrehë me një zemër të artë. Ata i punojnë një truk Greit të bukur dhe të pasur duke shpresuar për një darkë të mirë, por Grei e prekur nga gjendja e tyre vendos t’i marrë në shtëpine e saj.

programme.title: Doktori i Grave
programme.desc: Jeta e një gjinekologu të famshëm merr kthesa të papritura, kur gratë që e rrethojnë fillojnë të ndikojnë në mënyra të papritura në jetën e tij.

programme.title: Xhek Riçer
programme.desc: Kur 5 njerëz të pafajshëm vriten nga një snajper, provat të çojnë tek nje i dyshuar, i arrestuar nga policia. Por gjatë pyetësorit, i dyshuari jep vetëm një përgjigje: ’Sillni Xhek Riçer’... Kush është në të vërtetë vrasësi?

programme.title: Përmbaruesit
programme.desc: Jude Law, Forest Whitaker, Liev Schreiber. Një njeri i cili punon për një kompani që rimbledh organet që s’mund të paguhen nga klientët, merr arratinë kur ai vetë nuk arrin të paguajë zemrën e tij artificiale...

programme.title: Xhuno
programme.desc: Ellen Page, kandidate për çmimin Oskar. Film fitues i çmimit Oskar. Historia e Xhunos, një vajze adoleshente, që pasi ngelet shtatzënë, fillon kërkimin për të gjetur prindërit perfekt për fëmijën e saj...

programme.title: Bastardë pa lavdi
programme.desc: Fitues i çmimit Oskar me Brad Pitt. Një grup ushtarësh amerikanë me origjinë hebreje mbërrijnë në territorin francez me një mision special: asgjësimin e një numri sa më të madh nazistësh, me në krye Fyhrerin.

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Jeta për Mr. Bean, është një sfidë dhe kudo ku ai shkon gjithçka kthehet përmbys. E megjithë këto, falë këmbënguljes së tij, ai gjithmonë gjen një zgjidhje...

programme.title: Dashuria vjen papritur
programme.desc: Aaron Eckhart, Jennifer Aniston. Një njeri i ve, që ka shkruar një libër mbi vetëshërimin shpirtëror, njihet me një vajzë në një nga seminaret e tij, e cila e bën të kuptojë se ende nuk është përballur me humbjen e së shoqes...

programme.title: Pushime në rulotë
programme.desc: Një familje niset për pushime me rulotë dhe të papriturat s’do të kenë fund. Bobi i ka premtuar gruas dhe fëmijëve pushime të paharrueshme në Havai, por në fakt i merr me vete në Kolorado ku ka një takim të rëndësishëm pune.

programme.title: Romeo+Zhulieta
programme.desc: Historia klasike e dashurisë tragjike shekspiriane të Romeos dhe Zhulietës, tashmë vjen nga plazhi i Veronës në Los Anxhelos, nën dritën e yjeve modernë. Kandidat për çmimin Oskar.

programme.title: Elizabethtaun
programme.desc: Orlando Bloom, Kirsten Dunst. Në ditën më të keqe të jetës së tij, një i ri njihet me një stjuardesë simpatike, plot gjallëri dhe që nga ky moment jeta e tij s’do të jetë më kurrë njësoj...

programme.title: Imagjino sikur
programme.desc: Evani është një baba me kohë të pjesshme dhe një ekspert financiar me kohë të plotë. Kur karriera e tij fillon të marrë të tatëpjetën, çuditërisht ai do të gjejë përgjigjet e probleme të tij financiare tek miqtë imagjinarë që gjenden në botën e fantazise

programme.title: Një burrë i quajtur Oto
programme.desc: Bazuar në romanin bestseller të Fredrik Backman. Pas humbjes së gruas së tij, Oto (Tom Hanks), një burrë rreth të 60-ave, është shndërruar në inatçi dhe nuk ka më interes për asgjë. Kur një familje e re zhvendoset pranë shtëpisë së tij, ai zë miqësi me Marisol-in, një grua shtatzënë dhe shumë e dashur, e cila do ta ndryshojë tërësisht botën e tij.

programme.title: Xhek Riçer 2: Pa kthim prapa
programme.desc: Tom Cruise. Kur Suzan Tërner, drejtuesja e njësisë së Xhek Riçerit arrestohet për tradhti, ai do të bëjë gjithçka për të provuar pafajësinë e saj. Në misionin e tij të rrezikshëm, ai zbulon dhe pëpiqet të ndalë një konspiracion në majat më të larta të qeversië, ku shumë ushtarë po humbin jetën në mënyra misterioze...

programme.title: Njeriu me shenjë
programme.desc: Regjia: Brian de Palma. Skenari: Oliver Stone. Me Al Pacino, Steven Bauer, Michelle Pfeiffer. I cilësuar si një nga 100 filmat më të mirë të të gjitha kohërave.Toni Montana është një emigrant kubanez, ambicia e të cilit do të çojë në luftë mes organizatave dhe trafikantëve më të mëdhenj të drogës në Majami, e deri në krijimin e vetë perandorisë së tij.

programme.title: Kukun
programme.desc: A group of aliens return to earth to retrieve cocoons containing the people they’d left behind from an earlier trip. These cocoons had been resting at the bottom of the ocean. Once retrieved, they stored these recovered cocoons in the swimming pool of a house they’d rented in a small Florida town. Their mission is hampered by a number of elderly people from a nearby retirement community who had been secretly using the pool, and who discover unusual powers from within these cocoons.

programme.title: Kafshë nokturne
programme.desc: Amy Adams, Jake Gyllenhaal. Pronarja e një galerie arti lexon një roman të shkruar nga ish bashkëshorti i saj dhe fillon të dyshojë se historia e frikshme është e frymëzuar nga martesa e tyre dhe se jeta e saj është në rrezik.

programme.title: Doktori i Grave
programme.desc: Jeta e një gjinekologu të famshëm merr kthesa të papritura, kur gratë që e rrethojnë fillojnë të ndikojnë në mënyra të papritura në jetën e tij.

programme.title: Kaçurrelja Su
programme.desc: Bill Danser dhe kaçurrelja Su jane 2 të pastrehë me një zemër të artë. Ata i punojnë një truk Greit të bukur dhe të pasur duke shpresuar për një darkë të mirë, por Grei e prekur nga gjendja e tyre vendos t’i marrë në shtëpine e saj.

programme.title: Çokollatë
programme.desc: Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp. Janë vitet 50-të dhe në një qytet të vogël francez koha duket se ka ndaluar. Por mbërritja e një artisteje të mistershme bën të ndryshojë gjithçka me ndihmën e një muzikanti cigan. Një film i mbushur me fantazi dhe ëmbëlsi.

programme.title: Sprova e familjes
programme.desc: Dermot Mulroney, Sarah Jessica Parker, Claire Danes. Një grua e suksesshme në biznes dhe serioze, shkon për vizitë në shtëpinë e të dashurit të saj, por që në momentin e parë duket qartë se diferencat janë shumë të mëdha.

programme.title: Një seri ngjarjesh fatkeqe
programme.desc: Jim Carrey, Emily Browning, Liam Aiken, Billy Connolly, Meryl Streep. Në këtë film do të shikoni një seri ngjarjesh fatkeqe që u ndodhin jetimëve Bodeler. Në rolin e xhaxhait të tmerrshëm Konti Olaf, aktori i mirënjohur Jim Carrey.

programme.title: Atje ku këndojnë karavidhet
programme.desc: Me Daisy Edgar-Jones, Taylor John Smith, Harris Dickinson. Ekranizimi i një prej romaneve më të bujshëm të viteve të fundit. Një vajzë e vogël, e braktisur nga familja dhe shoqëria, rritet e vetme mes moçaleve. Ajo bëhet e dyshuara kryesore në një vrasje.

programme.title: Pagesa
programme.desc: Pasi mëson se kujtesa e tij është fshirë, një inxhinier kompjuterash merr arratinë dhe përpiqet të zbulojë të vërtetën, ndërkohë që ndiqet nga vrasës të shumtë...

programme.title: Endrra amerikane
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Mandy Moore. Emocionet e garës muzikore ’Ëndrra amerikane’, kanë përfshirë gjithë vendin, madje edhe presidentin. Por askush s’e ka kuptuar se në finale kanë arritur dy njerëz, secili me një sekret shumë të madh.

programme.title: Robin Hud
programme.desc: Historia e Robin Hudit dhe luftës së tij për drejtësi e sjellë nga aktorët më të njohur të Hollivudit.

programme.title: Titanët e Paqësorit 2: Rebelimi
programme.desc: Me John Boyega. Piloti rebel, Xheik Pentekost do të bashkojë forcat me një hakere15-vjeçare dhe me ish-kolegun e tij, kundër një kërcënimi të ri alien. Ata do ta çojnë në një shkallë tjetër këte aventurë spektakolare.

programme.title: Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Një burrë i quajtur Oto
programme.desc: Bazuar në romanin bestseller të Fredrik Backman. Pas humbjes së gruas së tij, Oto (Tom Hanks), një burrë rreth të 60-ave, është shndërruar në inatçi dhe nuk ka më interes për asgjë. Kur një familje e re zhvendoset pranë shtëpisë së tij, ai zë miqësi me Marisol-in, një grua shtatzënë dhe shumë e dashur, e cila do ta ndryshojë tërësisht botën e tij.

programme.title: Imagjino sikur
programme.desc: Evani është një baba me kohë të pjesshme dhe një ekspert financiar me kohë të plotë. Kur karriera e tij fillon të marrë të tatëpjetën, çuditërisht ai do të gjejë përgjigjet e probleme të tij financiare tek miqtë imagjinarë që gjenden në botën e fantazise

programme.title: Xhek Riçer
programme.desc: Kur 5 njerëz të pafajshëm vriten nga një snajper, provat të çojnë tek nje i dyshuar, i arrestuar nga policia. Por gjatë pyetësorit, i dyshuari jep vetëm një përgjigje: ’Sillni Xhek Riçer’... Kush është në të vërtetë vrasësi?

programme.title: Pleqtë gërnjarë
programme.desc: Jack Lemon, Walter Matthau. Një grindje mes dy fqinjësh që zgjat një jetë të tërë që prej kohërave të fëmijërisë përkeqësohet edhe më kur një fqinjë e re vjen të banojë në anën tjetër të rrugës.

programme.title: Lajl Krokodili
programme.desc: Bazuar në librin për fëmijë nga Bernard Waber. Djaloshi Xhosh, po përpiqet të përshtatet me qytetin e ri, ku familja e tij është transferuar. Ndërkohë ai zbulon Lajlin, një krokodil këngëtar, shumë i dashur dhe i mirë. Por miqësia e tyre kërcënohet nga fqinji i lig. Tani Xhosh dhe i zoti karizmatik i Lajlit, Hektori (Javier Bardem), do bëjnë gjithçka për ta mbrojtur atë nga pjesa tjetër e botës.

programme.title: Bed of Roses
programme.desc: Romantic drama about a young career girl who is swept off her feet by a shy florist, who fell in love with her after one glimpse through a shadowy window.

programme.title: Raporti i pakicës
programme.desc: Në të ardhmen, një program që zbulon krimet para se të ndodhin, identifikon një nga oficerët më të mirë si personin e rradhës dhe ai duhet të marrë arratinë dhe të zbulojë të vërtetën

programme.title: Ish Makina
programme.desc: Domhnall Gleeson, Alicia Vikander, Oscar Isaac. Një programues i ri përzgjidhet për të vlerësuar aftësitë e një roboteje bukuroshe që mendon dhe ndien si një njeri. Film fitues i një çmimi Oskar dhe 74 çmimeve të tjerë.

programme.title: Eduard Duargërshëra
programme.desc: Johnny Depp, Winona Ryder. Historia e Eduardit, një të riu që në vend të duarve ka gërshërë. Pas shumë vitesh vetmie, ai vendos të largohet nga kështjella për të jetuar mes njerëzve, dhe për të provuar çdo ndjenjë deri atëherë të panjohur për të.

programme.title: Swat
programme.desc: Collin Farell. Kriminelet e te gjithe Amerikes do te benin çdo gje per te nxjerre nga burgu Bosin e droges Alex Montel per nje shperblim prej 100 milione $.

programme.title: Resident Alien
programme.desc: Një alien i ardhur në tokë merr identitetin e një mjeku të qytetit të vogël të Kolorados dhe ngadalë fillon të luftojë me dilemën morale të misionit të tij sekret në Tokë.

programme.title: Atje ku këndojnë karavidhet
programme.desc: Me Daisy Edgar-Jones, Taylor John Smith, Harris Dickinson. Ekranizimi i një prej romaneve më të bujshëm të viteve të fundit. Një vajzë e vogël, e braktisur nga familja dhe shoqëria, rritet e vetme mes moçaleve. Ajo bëhet e dyshuara kryesore në një vrasje.

programme.title: Një seri ngjarjesh fatkeqe
programme.desc: Jim Carrey, Emily Browning, Liam Aiken, Billy Connolly, Meryl Streep. Në këtë film do të shikoni një seri ngjarjesh fatkeqe që u ndodhin jetimëve Bodeler. Në rolin e xhaxhait të tmerrshëm Konti Olaf, aktori i mirënjohur Jim Carrey.

programme.title: Xhek Riçer 2: Pa kthim prapa
programme.desc: Tom Cruise. Kur Suzan Tërner, drejtuesja e njësisë së Xhek Riçerit arrestohet për tradhti, ai do të bëjë gjithçka për të provuar pafajësinë e saj. Në misionin e tij të rrezikshëm, ai zbulon dhe pëpiqet të ndalë një konspiracion në majat më të larta të qeversië, ku shumë ushtarë po humbin jetën në mënyra misterioze...

programme.title: Pleqtë edhe më gërnjarë
programme.desc: Gjërat s’kanë ndryshuar shumë në kontenë Wabasha. Maksi dhe Xhoni ende mbajnë mëri, edhe pse Xhoni 6 muaj më parë u martua me banoren më të re. Tani të gjithë mendojnë se është radha e Maksit.

programme.title: Luftë me gjyshin
programme.desc: Piteri dhe gjyshi i tij, Edi, dikur ishin shumë të afërt, por kur gjyshi vjen të jetojë me familjen, Piteri është i detyruar të heqë dorë nga pasuria e tij më e çmuar: dhoma e tij e gjumit...

programme.title: Paso nderin
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Haley Joel Osment, Helen Hunt. Historia e një djali 11 vjeçar, që prezantohet me një projekt shkollor. Ai hedh idene që çdo personi të cilit i bëhet një nder, ta pasojë tek të tjerët...

programme.title: Njerëz të humbur
programme.desc: Bazuar në romanin investigativ nga shkrimtari amerikan Dennis Lehane, autor i ’Lumi Mistik’. Nën regjinë e Ben Affleck. Me Morgan Freeman, Ed Harris, Casey Affleck...

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: Fituesi i çmimit Oskar, Russell Crowe dhe regjisori Ridley Scott, sjellin historinë e njeriut që u bë legjendë. Një njeri sfidon tiraninë e mbretit dhe kthehet në një hero të jashtëligjshëm, që ndryshon përgjithmonë historinë e një kombi.

programme.title: Kalorësi i parë
programme.desc: Kur ai fiton vendin e tij në ”Tryezën e Rrumbullakët”, Lancelotit (Richard Gere) - një shpatar i zoti, i duhet të balancojë besnikërinë ndaj fronit, me dashurinë e tij të madhe për Gjenevrën (Julia Ormond), gruan e ardhshme të mbretit Arthur (Sean Connery).

programme.title: Xhuno
programme.desc: Ellen Page, kandidate për çmimin Oskar. Film fitues i çmimit Oskar. Historia e Xhunos, një vajze adoleshente, që pasi ngelet shtatzënë, fillon kërkimin për të gjetur prindërit perfekt për fëmijën e saj...

programme.title: Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Doktori i Grave
programme.desc: Jeta e një gjinekologu të famshëm merr kthesa të papritura, kur gratë që e rrethojnë fillojnë të ndikojnë në mënyra të papritura në jetën e tij.

programme.title: Romeo+Zhulieta
programme.desc: Historia klasike e dashurisë tragjike shekspiriane të Romeos dhe Zhulietës, tashmë vjen nga plazhi i Veronës në Los Anxhelos, nën dritën e yjeve modernë. Kandidat për çmimin Oskar.

programme.desc: Kur 5 njerëz të pafajshëm vriten nga një snajper, provat të çojnë tek nje i dyshuar, i arrestuar nga policia. Por gjatë pyetësorit, i dyshuari jep vetëm një përgjigje: ’Sillni Xhek Riçer’... Kush është në të vërtetë vrasësi?

programme.title: Diktatori
programme.desc: Sacha Baron Cohen. Diktatori më famëkeq i ditëve tona, shkon në Nju Jork. Pas një sërë ngjarjesh do të humbasë pushtetin edhe mjekrën, pa të cilën nuk e njeh askush. Këtu fillon makthi i tij më i madh:përjetimi i ’Ëndrrës Amerikane’.

programme.title: Kërcim dashurie
programme.desc: Jennifer Grey. Fitues i çmimit Oskar dhe shumë çmimeve të tjera. Një vajzë e pasur do të dashurohet me mësuesin e vallëzimit gjatë pushimeve të saj në një kamp veror. Ajo do të luftojë kundër planeve që ka familja e saj për të duke ndjekur pasionin.

programme.title: Wall Street: Paraja nuk fle kurrë
programme.desc: Pas daljes nga burgu, një financier i korruptuar, krijon afrimitet me të fejuarin e vajzës - një agjent burse, vetëm që të rihyjë me çdo kusht në botën e vetme që njeh

programme.title: Anakonda
programme.desc: J. Lopez. Në skajet e thella të xhunglës së Amazones, një grup xhirimi do të shpëtojnë jetën e një njeriu misterioz, qëllimet e të cilit do të ndryshojnë pabesisht itinerarin e tyre drejt një udhëtimi të rrezikshëm në zemër të xhunglës.

programme.title: Shpëtoni ushtarin Rajan
programme.desc: Një kryevepër e kinematografisë. Film fitues i 5 çmimeve Oskar. Nga regjisori Steven Spielberg. Me Tom Hanks, Matt Damon, Edward Burns dhe Tom Sizemore. Lufta e II Botërore. Një grup i vogël ushtarësh, nisen me një mison: të gjejnë dhe të marrin me vete ushtarin Rajan, vëllezërit e të cilit ishin vrarë të gjithë në luftë.

programme.title: Çokollatë
programme.desc: Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp. Janë vitet 50-të dhe në një qytet të vogël francez koha duket se ka ndaluar. Por mbërritja e një artisteje të mistershme bën të ndryshojë gjithçka me ndihmën e një muzikanti cigan. Një film i mbushur me fantazi dhe ëmbëlsi.

programme.title: Xhek Riçer 2: Pa kthim prapa

programme.title: Elizabethtaun
programme.desc: Orlando Bloom, Kirsten Dunst. Në ditën më të keqe të jetës së tij, një i ri njihet me një stjuardesë simpatike, plot gjallëri dhe që nga ky moment jeta e tij s’do të jetë më kurrë njësoj...

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Ewan McGregor. Musical fitues i 2 çmimeve Oskar. Dashuria për Satin, një kurtizane në Moulin Rouge, duhet të jetë vetëm interes. Por kur ajo njihet me Kristian, një poet ëndërrimtar, dashuria për të do të marrë një tjetër kuptim.

programme.title: Aviatori
programme.desc: Kjo eshte historia e jashtezakonshme e Hauard Hjugs, njeriu qe guxoi dhe theu te gjitha rregullat. Hauard mund te realizonte gjithe çka deshironte, ndertoi avionin me te madh dhe kishte grate me te bukura te botes.

programme.title: Shtrigat e Istuikut
programme.desc: Vetëm dy janë ata që mund të luajnë rolin e Djallit: Ai vetë... dhe Jack Nicholson. Ai do të ketë rreth vetes tre nga femrat më të bukura të Hollivudit. Cher, Susan Sarandon, Michelle Pfeiffer, të cilat do të jenë 3 shtrigat e Uistuikut...

programme.title: Përmbaruesit
programme.desc: Jude Law, Forest Whitaker, Liev Schreiber. Një njeri i cili punon për një kompani që rimbledh organet që s’mund të paguhen nga klientët, merr arratinë kur ai vetë nuk arrin të paguajë zemrën e tij artificiale...

programme.title: Xhoni Inglish 1
programme.desc: Rowan Atkinson, John Malkovich, Natalie Imbruglia. Parodi e filmave të agjentit 007. Xhoni Inglish, agjenti sekret më optmist, por edhe më i paafti, vihet në kërkim të një francezi, që kërkon të zërë vendin e Mbretëreshës.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: When humble rancher Rick Patterson marries movie star Sabrina Eastman, his son Josh (10) finds himself with a new step-sister, Lacey (14). Josh is an introverted boy who doesn’t have a lot of confidence and Lacey is a spoiled Hollywood brat who’s angry at Sabrina for not letting her have her own reality show. The two kids do not get along and neither do their respective dogs: Josh’s dog Meatball is a scruffy, farm mutt who’s laid-back and friendly; Cassie is a prim, spoiled, purse city dog who is not into country living. Rick and Sabrina go on their honeymoon for a couple of days, leaving Lacey and Josh in the care of Krystal, a hippie-trippy New Age neighbour. When Lacey sees some people outside the house one night, she starts to think someone is watching the house but Josh dismisses her fears. However, as Cassie quickly develops her ’country nose’, she learns that Lacey wasn’t wrong. She and Meatball discover that a pair of bumbling crooks, Louie and Terrance, are plotting to steal ...

programme.title: Tin cup
programme.desc: Kevin Costner. Roi Tin Kap MekAvoi është një ish lojtar golfi që po kalon disa vështirësi financiare. Një ditë në derën e tij shfaqet psikiatra Molli e cila dëshiron të marrë leksione golfi.

programme.title: Vëllezërit Grim
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Health Ledger, Monica Bellucci. Gjatë perandorisë Napoleoniane vëllezërit Grim jetonin duke mashtruar e praktikuar formula magjike. Kur autoritetet franceze i zbulojnë, ata për të shpëtuar fshihen në një pyll të magjepsur.

programme.title: Dritarja e fshehtë
programme.desc: Pas ndarjes me të shoqen, shkrimtari i famshëm Mort Rainey, përballet papritur, në shtëpinë e tij të vetmuar buzë liqenit me një te panjohur të rrezikshëm. Quhet John Shooter dhe pretendon se Ranye i ka kopjuar tregimin e tij.

programme.title: Ekzorcizmi i Emili Rouz
programme.desc: Laura Linney. Bazuar në një histori të vërtete. Kisha Katolike e Romës njohu zyrtarisht pushtimin nga djajtë të një vajze 19-vjeçare. Ekzorcizmi i saj u regjistrua dhe ai regjistrim luajti një rol vendimtar në ngjarjet që pasuan.

programme.title: Njeriu me shenjë
programme.desc: Regjia: Brian de Palma. Skenari: Oliver Stone. Me Al Pacino, Steven Bauer, Michelle Pfeiffer. I cilësuar si një nga 100 filmat më të mirë të të gjitha kohërave.Toni Montana është një emigrant kubanez, ambicia e të cilit do të çojë në luftë mes organizatave dhe trafikantëve më të mëdhenj të drogës në Majami, e deri në krijimin e vetë perandorisë së tij.

programme.desc: Piteri dhe gjyshi i tij, Edi, dikur ishin shumë të afërt, por kur gjyshi vjen të jetojë me familjen, Piteri është i detyruar të heqë dorë nga pasuria e tij më e çmuar: dhoma e tij e gjumit...

programme.title: Paso nderin
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Haley Joel Osment, Helen Hunt. Historia e një djali 11 vjeçar, që prezantohet me një projekt shkollor. Ai hedh idene që çdo personi të cilit i bëhet një nder, ta pasojë tek të tjerët...

programme.title: Kërcim dashurie
programme.desc: Jennifer Grey. Fitues i çmimit Oskar dhe shumë çmimeve të tjera. Një vajzë e pasur do të dashurohet me mësuesin e vallëzimit gjatë pushimeve të saj në një kamp veror. Ajo do të luftojë kundër planeve që ka familja e saj për të duke ndjekur pasionin.

programme.title: Xhoni Inglish 2: Ringjallja
programme.desc: Rowan Atkinson. Xhoni Inglish, spiuni më i rrezikshëm, në vitet që u zhduk pa asnjë gjurmë, përsosi teknikat e tij. Tani që një organizatë kriminale po përgatit një atentat, vetëm ai me mënyrat e tij, mund të parandalojnë rrezikun...

programme.title: Lassie Come Home
programme.desc: Cinema’s most famous dog returns in a modern re-telling of a classic story. Lassie and 12-year-old Florian are inseparable playmates, so it breaks both their hearts when Lassie is sent away after Florian’s father Andreas loses his job. While Lassie’s temporary minders, which includes 12-year-old Priscilla, mean well; Lassie is mistreated by an opportunist caretaker and escapes the first chance she gets. It is the start of an epic adventure across southern Germany as Lassie makes her way back home while Florien and Priscilla set out to find her. Both human and canine characters face many challenges and obstacles, but the bond between a child and their dog is not one that can be severed easily. Eighty years after Lassie first captured hearts in English novelist Eric Mowbray Knight’s classic Lassie Come-Home, the iconic long-haired collie is ready to be discovered once more by a whole new generation.

programme.title: Vallëzimi
programme.desc: Rafaelit sapo i vdiq e ëma dhe shkon në Hjuston për të takuar për herë të parë babanë.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ndikuar nga rrezatimi i disa eksperimenteve bërthamore, Godzilla, ky përbindësh gjigand do të terrorizojë botën mbarë. A do t’ia dalë mbanë e gjithë ushtria amerikane ta mposhtë?

programme.title: X-Files
programme.desc: This television series follows the adventures and lives of FBI agents investigating those cases that involve the paranormal or previously unsolved (especially by conventional means). FBI Special Agents Mulder, Scully, Doggett and Reyes work to uncover forces within the United States of America government that would violate people’s rights, alien creatures and monsters alike that attack, and other mysteries.

programme.title: Anabela
programme.desc: Ward Horton, Annabelle Wallis. Përpara ngjarjeve të frikshme ne ’Dosjet Uorren’, ekzistonte kukulla Anabel. Kjo kukull iu dha Mias nga Xhoni, i cili mendonte se ishte dhurata perfekte... Por a do të jetë vërtet kështu?

programme.title: Endrra amerikane
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Mandy Moore. Emocionet e garës muzikore ’Ëndrra amerikane’, kanë përfshirë gjithë vendin, madje edhe presidentin. Por askush s’e ka kuptuar se në finale kanë arritur dy njerëz, secili me një sekret shumë të madh.

programme.title: Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Resident Alien
programme.desc: Një alien i ardhur në tokë merr identitetin e një mjeku të qytetit të vogël të Kolorados dhe ngadalë fillon të luftojë me dilemën morale të misionit të tij sekret në Tokë.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: When humble rancher Rick Patterson marries movie star Sabrina Eastman, his son Josh (10) finds himself with a new step-sister, Lacey (14). Josh is an introverted boy who doesn’t have a lot of confidence and Lacey is a spoiled Hollywood brat who’s angry at Sabrina for not letting her have her own reality show. The two kids do not get along and neither do their respective dogs: Josh’s dog Meatball is a scruffy, farm mutt who’s laid-back and friendly; Cassie is a prim, spoiled, purse city dog who is not into country living. Rick and Sabrina go on their honeymoon for a couple of days, leaving Lacey and Josh in the care of Krystal, a hippie-trippy New Age neighbour. When Lacey sees some people outside the house one night, she starts to think someone is watching the house but Josh dismisses her fears. However, as Cassie quickly develops her ’country nose’, she learns that Lacey wasn’t wrong. She and Meatball discover that a pair of bumbling crooks, Louie and Terrance, are plotting to steal ...

programme.title: Tin cup
programme.desc: Kevin Costner. Roi Tin Kap MekAvoi është një ish lojtar golfi që po kalon disa vështirësi financiare. Një ditë në derën e tij shfaqet psikiatra Molli e cila dëshiron të marrë leksione golfi.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Ewan McGregor. Musical fitues i 2 çmimeve Oskar. Dashuria për Satin, një kurtizane në Moulin Rouge, duhet të jetë vetëm interes. Por kur ajo njihet me Kristian, një poet ëndërrimtar, dashuria për të do të marrë një tjetër kuptim.

programme.title: Xhoni Inglish 3: Sërish në aksion
programme.desc: Rowan Atkinson. Pasi një sulm kompjuterik zbulon identitetet e të gjithë agjentëve të infiltruar të Britanisë, shpresa e vetme e kombit, Xhoni Inglish detyrohet të lërë pensionin e të kthehet në detyrë, për të zbuluar ideatorin e sulmit.

programme.title: Lassie a new adventure
programme.desc: Protagonistja e qenve Collie, Lassie, heton zhdukjet misterioze të disa qenve të origjinës, me ndihmën e mikut më të mirë Flo dhe shokëve të rinj Henri, Kleo dhe Pippa e vogël, një Jack Russell Terrier.

programme.title: Sigurisht, ndoshta
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Abigail Breslin. Me kërkesën e së bijës, një baba në prag divorci, i rrëfen asaj tri marrëdhëniet sentimentale më të rëndësishme të jetës. Duke u ndërruar emrat grave, e bija duhet të gjejë se cila prej tyre është nëna e saj.

programme.title: King Kongu
programme.desc: Në një ishull misterioz për të realizuar një film, stafi i xhirimit dhe aktorët, zbulojnë një gorrilla gjigante të quajtur King Kong...

programme.title: Morbius
programme.desc: Fituesi i çmimit ’Oskar’ Jard Leto vjen si biokimisti Majkëll Morbius. I infektuar nga një sëmundje e rrallë dhe shumë e rrezikshme gjaku, Dr. Morbius është i vendosur të gjejë një kurë, për të shpëtuar këdo që vuan fatin e tij. Por ajo që fillimisht duket si sukses, së shpejti rezulton të jetë një ilaç potencialisht më i rrezikshëm se vetë sëmundja...

programme.title: Dosjet Uorren 1
programme.desc: V.Farmiga, P.Wilson. Bazuar në një ngjarje të vërtetë. Një çift hetuesish që merren me fenomene të mbinatyrshme, shkojnë për të ndihmuar një familje që jeton në një fermë të pushtuar nga një shpirt djallëzor. Kjo do të jetë çështja më e vështirë e karrierës së tyre...

programme.title: Ish Makina
programme.desc: Domhnall Gleeson, Alicia Vikander, Oscar Isaac. Një programues i ri përzgjidhet për të vlerësuar aftësitë e një roboteje bukuroshe që mendon dhe ndien si një njeri. Film fitues i një çmimi Oskar dhe 74 çmimeve të tjerë.

programme.title: Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Lassie Come Home
programme.desc: Cinema’s most famous dog returns in a modern re-telling of a classic story. Lassie and 12-year-old Florian are inseparable playmates, so it breaks both their hearts when Lassie is sent away after Florian’s father Andreas loses his job. While Lassie’s temporary minders, which includes 12-year-old Priscilla, mean well; Lassie is mistreated by an opportunist caretaker and escapes the first chance she gets. It is the start of an epic adventure across southern Germany as Lassie makes her way back home while Florien and Priscilla set out to find her. Both human and canine characters face many challenges and obstacles, but the bond between a child and their dog is not one that can be severed easily. Eighty years after Lassie first captured hearts in English novelist Eric Mowbray Knight’s classic Lassie Come-Home, the iconic long-haired collie is ready to be discovered once more by a whole new generation.

programme.title: Vallëzimi
programme.desc: Rafaelit sapo i vdiq e ëma dhe shkon në Hjuston për të takuar për herë të parë babanë.

programme.title: Vëllezërit Grim
